Associated Students, Inc. at California State University Long Beach seeks a Web Developer to build and maintain websites for its departments. The role customizes CMS extensions, creates accessible reusable page components, and supports staff and customers with website needs.
Higher Education
Responsibilities
Coordinates assignments and communicates with the ASI Web and Application Developer Communications department, and staff
Build stunning, fun, and exciting web pages for various organizations within ASI
Gives assistance or technical directions where possible to fellow staff and the staff of other divisions on aspects of their websites
Meet with customers and discuss technical points, outline customers’ expectations, prioritize concerns, and set deadlines or timetables
Works with PHP, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript to customize extensions in Joomla and WordPress CMS to meet user requirements
Maintains an active job/change log
Creates page templates and reusable code to enhance continuity, readability, compatibility, accessibility, and navigation across all ASI web pages
Maintaining backend and experience with Hosting, Cloud and cPanel
Other duties as assigned, reasonably within the scope of the job

Required
Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP is required, as well as Strong knowledge of React, WordPress, Joomla or other CMS
The Web Developer will have strong knowledge of both backend and frontend frameworks
A minimum of one-year experience coding web pages in PHP, CSS, HTML and JS
A minimum of one-year experience using WordPress
A minimum of one-year experience using React or any other framework or libraries
Must be a current and active CSULB student enrolled in a minimum of 6 units
Proficient in developing websites using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without the use of graphical editors, with familiarity in content management systems such as Joomla, WordPress, and similar platforms
Demonstrates strong knowledge of web browsers, plug-ins, web accessibility standards, and ADA Section 508 compliance, as well as web design tools including Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and related applications
Experienced with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and other web hosting platforms; front-end and back-end development; React, Vue, Bootstrap, Tailwind, and other modern libraries and frameworks; reusable component-based development; GitHub workflows; and code editors such as VS Code
Familiar with current web optimization practices, coding and design conventions, and website analysis tools used to identify errors and performance bottlenecks
Able to work effectively on Windows-based systems and possess strong organizational, planning, collaboration, and user-centered design skills
Self-motivated, accountable, willing to learn new technologies, and able to meet project deadlines
